instruction: In apps/daemon/src/backend/pi.ts, isRetryableError matches any 5xx digit substring (such as request IDs like req-abc503def or localhost:5030) and retries permanent 404 / model-not-found / model-not-supported errors when the message also contains words like timeout or status 503. Fix isRetryableError so permanent 404 / model-not-found / not-supported errors return false and 5xx matching only triggers on genuine HTTP/status 5xx error phrases.
